# Full-course diagnostic — Week13 lesson1
Original 16-mark formative diagnostic (~30 minutes); use remaining lesson time to compare evidence and select priorities. Each item has two 1-mark criteria. Score identifies a gap, not a grade or course-completion verdict. Closed notes on first attempt; explain uncertainty. Use prior Unit 3/4 evidence as well as this sample.
P1: `grid=[[0]*2]*2; grid[0][1]=7`. Give grid (1) and explain shared-row aliasing (1).
P2: Binary search [3,6,9,12,15] for 12. Give mid/index trace 2 → 3 (1), and sorted-input precondition (1).
P3: In insertion sort [5,2,4,2], give list after inserting the value 4 (1), and explain why strict > retains equal-key order (1).
P4: Session.reserve refuses a full session; OnlineSession overrides location. Explain polymorphic location dispatch (1), and why `_booked` is not a security boundary or a DB constraint (1).
D1: Resource LEFT JOIN Loan: R04 has no loans. Explain COUNT(*) versus COUNT(LoanID) (1), and why a preserved NULL row must not be counted as an active loan (1).
D2: Loan insertion then invalid Inspection.Passed = 2 fails in one explicit transaction. Explain rollback of both-step operation (1), and why this alone cannot demonstrate crash durability (1).
N1: Traditional IPv4 subnet 192.168.40.64/27. Give usable range .65–.94 and broadcast .95 (1), and explain that a remote destination normally uses a next-hop gateway MAC on the first Ethernet segment rather than the remote server MAC (1).
S1: HTTPS export allowed in a hypothetical APP entity; no recipient/harm finding. Explain connection protection versus application permission (1), and why federal eligible-breach notification cannot be decided from this fact alone (1).
For each item record: independent response, criterion met/missing, likely cause, linked repair task. Choose TWO priority causes using stakes and repeated evidence, not just a grand total. If uncertainty spans all strands, teacher chooses prerequisite repairs and preserves later support needs.
